003.text: After a few days, the sky returns to normal.

005.text: Marisa has fallen into a deep sleep ever since the incident.

006.name: Marisa
006.text: Uggh. How long have I been asleep?

007.name: Marisa
007.text: Sky is clear? Looks like it's finally over.

008.name: Marisa
008.text: I wonder if Reimu has visited.

014.name: Marisa
014.text: My eyes weren't this color before.

015.name: Marisa
015.text: Was it the mist's fault? I knew I should've stayed home that day.

017.name: Marisa
017.text: I have a sudden urge to go to a place with a lot of humans.

019.name: Marisa
019.text: Oh dear something terrible happened hasn't it.

022.name: Marisa
022.text: Was going to visit Reimu but...

023.name: Marisa
023.text: I should stay away from her for now.

024.name: Marisa
024.text: I'll go to the village to... buy some meat.

028.text:
